scripts.predev: npm run packages:build && npm run runtime:generate && npm run learner-ui:app-generate
scripts.build: npm run packages:build && npm run open-learning:generate && npm run build:web
scripts.build:pages-course: npm run packages:build && LATENT_PRODUCT_HOME=courses LATENT_COURSE_HOME=llm-systems LATENT_LEARNING_SUITE_BASE_PATH=/latent LATENT_GITHUB_PAGES_BASE_PATH=/latent/llm-systems LATENT_STATIC_EXPORT_ORIGIN=https://model-systems-labs.github.io/latent/llm-systems npm run build:web && node scripts/prepare-pages-course-export.mjs /latent/llm-systems
scripts.build:web: npm run runtime:generate && npm run learner-ui:app-generate && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log vinext build && node scripts/prune-browser-only-ssr-assets.mjs
scripts.test: npm run packages:test && npm run build:web && npm run test:performance && npm run test:app
scripts.open-learning:generate: node packages/course-kit/bin/latent-learning.mjs schema public/open-learning/learning-pack.schema.json --force && node packages/course-kit/bin/latent-learning.mjs schema public/open-learning/learning-feed.schema.json --feed --force && node packages/course-kit/bin/latent-learning.mjs build examples/open-learning/reliable-llm-changes/learning-pack.json --out-dir public/open-learning/reliable-llm-changes && node scripts/generate-open-learning-public-docs.mjs
scripts.open-learning:schema: node packages/course-kit/bin/latent-learning.mjs schema docs/learning-pack.schema.json --force && node packages/course-kit/bin/latent-learning.mjs schema docs/learning-feed.schema.json --feed --force
scripts.learning-examples:validate: npm run learner-ui:check && npm run validate --prefix examples/learning-platform/interview-loop && npm run validate --prefix examples/learning-platform/ten-problems
scripts.learning-examples:build: npm run learner-ui:generate && npm run build:pages-course && npm run test:performance && node scripts/build-learning-example-pages.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run learning-examples:validate
scripts.artifacts:record-training: npm run build --workspace @latent/model-lab && npm run build --workspace @latent/training-replay && node scripts/generate-recorded-training.mjs
